description: Kalshi and Polymarket weather markets (high, low, rain) in a place: settlement station and rule, the value so far under that rule, forecast daily max/min (or rain) at the station, our value and the official result once settled. No prices: read them from the venue (each row's event and event_url). Needs place, family or venue. line ≈526 tok, table ≈1,757; every city ≈36,291. With none: the list of market cities. format=json also returns structuredContent; the JSON Schema is at https://groundhog.markets/api/v1/schema.json

date.description: today | tomorrow | yesterday | YYYY-MM-DD, each place's local date (default today)

family.description: high | low | rain | all (default all); alone: every market city

fields.description: full (default) | compact: leave out null JSON keys (format=json)

place.description: Slug, name, 'City, ST' or ICAO; an array for up to 10 places

venue.description: kalshi | polymarket (default both); alone: every market of that venue

name: markets
title: Weather markets
